description: Tempo & key reference labels for the Tempo & Key Finder benchmark (examples/tempo_key_benchmark.rs). Audio is NOT in the repo: point the benchmark at the folder holding 'Static Tempo/' and 'Tempo Change/'. Source: 'Key & Tempo.xlsx' (2026-09-24). Per song: file, key (required); tempos (playing order, one value = steady); optional tempo_map [{time, bpm}] and chords [{time, chord}] (timestamps in seconds, each mark holds until the next); meter (informational). Only the OMINOUS map has known positions (see its screenshot), so no song carries a tempo_map yet.
